title: No SSE tests for \r and \r\n line endings
description:
All SSE unit tests in sse.rs use Unix LF (
) line endings and LF-only blank line delimiters. The subscriber in client.rs handles 

, , and 

 delimiters and converts 
 and bare  to 
 before calling parse_sse_block. This code path is tested only by reading the source — there are no tests that send a CRLF-terminated SSE block or a CR-terminated block through the pipeline. A server using HTTP/1.1 with 
 line endings in the SSE body is a realistic scenario and the normalization path has never been executed in tests.
